query: UPDATE board_posts SET (account_id, board_id, icon, title, content, created_at, location, event_from, event_to, content_html, content_plain) = ($1, $2, $3, update_i18n_strings(title, $4, $5), update_i18n_strings(content, $6, $7), NOW(), update_i18n_strings(location, $8, $9), $10, $11, update_i18n_strings(content_html, $13, $14), update_i18n_strings(content_plain, $15, $16)) WHERE id = $12 RETURNING id
